import {
  defineApp,
  Screen,
  Stack,
  Row,
  Card,
  Text,
  Button,
  TextInput,
  List,
  ListItem,
  EmptyState,
  Modal,
  ProgressBar,
  Badge,
  toast,
  nav,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  storage,
  type SchemaArtifact,
} from 'vc-sdk';

// Trip Checklists: pack a list once as a template, then start a trip from it. Starting a trip
// copies every item into the trip's own rows, so ticking things off as you go never changes the
// template it came from. Templates and the running trip are settings in storage.kv.
const SCHEMA: SchemaArtifact = { schemaVersion: 1, collections: {} };

type Template = { id: string; name: string; items: string[] };
type TripItem = { text: string; checked: boolean };
type Trip = { id: string; templateId: string; name: string; items: TripItem[] };

const DEFAULT_TEMPLATES: Template[] = [
  {
    id: 'tpl-camping',
    name: 'Weekend camping',
    items: ['Tent and pegs', 'Sleeping bag', 'Torch and spare batteries', 'Water bottle', 'Snacks', 'Warm layer', 'Toothbrush'],
  },
  {
    id: 'tpl-beach',
    name: 'Beach day',
    items: ['Towel', 'Swimwear', 'Sunscreen', 'Sun hat', 'Water', 'Snorkel mask'],
  },
  {
    id: 'tpl-city',
    name: 'City break',
    items: ['Tickets', 'ID or passport', 'Phone charger', 'Umbrella', 'Comfortable shoes'],
  },
];

// Which template the editor screen is working on.
let editingId = '';

let idSeed = 0;
function newId(prefix: string): string {
  idSeed += 1;
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${idSeed}`;
}

function readTemplates(value: unknown): Template[] | null {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const out: Template[] = [];
  for (const raw of value) {
    if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null) continue;
    const row = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
    const items: string[] = Array.isArray(row.items)
      ? row.items.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string')
      : [];
    out.push({ id: String(row.id ?? newId('tpl')), name: String(row.name ?? ''), items });
  }
  return out;
}

function readTrip(value: unknown): Trip | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return null;
  const row = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const rawItems = Array.isArray(row.items) ? row.items : [];
  const items: TripItem[] = [];
  for (const raw of rawItems) {
    if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null) continue;
    const item = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
    items.push({ text: String(item.text ?? ''), checked: item.checked === true });
  }
  return {
    id: String(row.id ?? newId('trip')),
    templateId: String(row.templateId ?? ''),
    name: String(row.name ?? 'Trip'),
    items,
  };
}

function templateTitle(template: Template): string {
  return template.name.trim() === '' ? 'Untitled list' : template.name;
}

function countLabel(n: number): string {
  return n === 1 ? '1 item' : `${n} items`;
}

// ── Templates: every saved list, plus the trip that is currently running ──────
function Templates() {
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState<Template[]>(DEFAULT_TEMPLATES);
  const [trip, setTrip] = useState<Trip | null>(null);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    (async () => {
      const savedTemplates = await storage.kv.get('templates');
      const savedTrip = await storage.kv.get('activeTrip');
      if (!live) return;
      const parsed = readTemplates(savedTemplates);
      if (parsed !== null) setTemplates(parsed);
      setTrip(readTrip(savedTrip));
    })().catch(() => {
      if (live) toast('Couldn’t load your templates.');
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const writeTemplates = (next: Template[]) => {
    setTemplates(next);
    storage.kv.set('templates', next).catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save your templates.'));
  };

  const opened = templates.find((template) => template.id === openId) ?? null;

  const createTemplate = () => {
    const trimmed = name.trim();
    if (trimmed === '') return;
    const template: Template = { id: newId('tpl'), name: trimmed, items: [] };
    writeTemplates([...templates, template]);
    setCreating(false);
    setName('');
    editingId = template.id;
    nav.navigate('Editor');
  };

  // The trip takes its own copy of every item: the template is left exactly as it was.
  const startTrip = (template: Template) => {
    const next: Trip = {
      id: newId('trip'),
      templateId: template.id,
      name: templateTitle(template),
      items: template.items.map((text) => ({ text, checked: false })),
    };
    setTrip(next);
    setOpenId(null);
    storage.kv
      .set('activeTrip', next)
      .then(() => toast('New trip started'))
      .catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save the new trip.'));
    nav.navigate('Trip');
  };

  const finishTrip = () => {
    setTrip(null);
    storage.kv.remove('activeTrip').catch(() => toast('Couldn’t clear the trip.'));
    toast('Trip finished');
  };

  const editTemplate = (template: Template) => {
    editingId = template.id;
    setOpenId(null);
    nav.navigate('Editor');
  };

  return (
    <Screen title="Trip Checklists" action={{ icon: 'plus', label: 'New template', onPress: () => setCreating(true) }}>
      <Stack gap="lg">
        {trip && (
          <Card>
            <Stack gap="sm">
              <Row justify="between">
                <Text weight="semibold">{trip.name}</Text>
                <Badge label="Trip in progress" tone="primary" />
              </Row>
              <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">
                Ticking items off a trip never changes the template it came from.
              </Text>
              <Row>
                <Button label="Resume trip" variant="secondary" icon="list-checks" onPress={() => nav.navigate('Trip')} />
                <Button label="Finish trip" variant="danger" icon="check" onPress={finishTrip} />
              </Row>
            </Stack>
          </Card>
        )}

        <Stack gap="sm">
          <Text size="subtitle">Templates</Text>
          <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Tap a template to start a trip from it or edit its items.</Text>
          {templates.length === 0 ? (
            <Card>
              <EmptyState icon="list-checks" title="No templates yet" hint="Tap + to save the list you always pack." />
            </Card>
          ) : (
            <List
              items={templates}
              keyBy="id"
              renderItem={(template) => (
                <ListItem
                  title={templateTitle(template)}
                  subtitle={countLabel(template.items.length)}
                  icon="list-checks"
                  onPress={() => setOpenId(template.id)}
                />
              )}
            />
          )}
        </Stack>
      </Stack>

      <Modal visible={creating} title="New template" onClose={() => setCreating(false)}>
        <Stack gap="lg">
          <TextInput label="Template name" value={name} placeholder="Winter hiking" onChange={setName} />
          <Button label="Create and add items" icon="plus" disabled={name.trim() === ''} onPress={createTemplate} />
        </Stack>
      </Modal>

      <Modal visible={opened !== null} title={opened === null ? 'Template' : templateTitle(opened)} onClose={() => setOpenId(null)}>
        {opened && (
          <Stack gap="lg">
            <Text color="text-muted">
              {opened.items.length === 0
                ? 'This template has no items yet.'
                : `${countLabel(opened.items.length)}: ${opened.items.join(' · ')}`}
            </Text>
            <Button label="Start a new trip" icon="list-checks" onPress={() => startTrip(opened)} />
            <Row>
              <Button label="Edit items" variant="secondary" icon="pencil" onPress={() => editTemplate(opened)} />
              <Button
                label="Delete"
                variant="danger"
                icon="trash-2"
                onPress={() => {
                  setOpenId(null);
                  writeTemplates(templates.filter((template) => template.id !== opened.id));
                  toast('Template deleted');
                }}
              />
            </Row>
          </Stack>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </Screen>
  );
}

// ── Template Editor: the item list of one template, saved as it is typed ──────
function Editor() {
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState<Template[] | null>(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    storage.kv
      .get('templates')
      .then((saved) => {
        if (live) setTemplates(readTemplates(saved) ?? DEFAULT_TEMPLATES);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (live) {
          setTemplates(DEFAULT_TEMPLATES);
          toast('Couldn’t load the template.');
        }
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const template = templates === null ? null : templates.find((row) => row.id === editingId) ?? null;

  const write = (next: Template[]) => {
    setTemplates(next);
    storage.kv.set('templates', next).catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save that.'));
  };

  const saveName = (next: string) => {
    if (templates === null || template === null) return;
    write(templates.map((row) => (row.id === template.id ? { id: row.id, name: next, items: row.items } : row)));
  };

  const saveItems = (next: string[]) => {
    if (templates === null || template === null) return;
    write(templates.map((row) => (row.id === template.id ? { id: row.id, name: row.name, items: next } : row)));
  };

  const addItem = () => {
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (template === null || text === '') return;
    saveItems([...template.items, text]);
    setDraft('');
  };

  if (templates === null) {
    return (
      <Screen title="Template">
        <Stack>
          <Text color="text-muted">Loading your template…</Text>
        </Stack>
      </Screen>
    );
  }

  if (template === null) {
    return (
      <Screen title="Template">
        <Stack gap="lg">
          <Card>
            <EmptyState icon="list-checks" title="This template is gone" hint="Go back and pick another one." />
          </Card>
          <Button label="Back to templates" variant="secondary" onPress={() => nav.back()} />
        </Stack>
      </Screen>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Screen title={templateTitle(template)}>
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <TextInput label="Template name" value={template.name} placeholder="Weekend camping" onChange={saveName} />

        <Stack gap="sm">
          <Text size="subtitle">Items</Text>
          <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Tap an item to remove it. Trips already started keep their own copy.</Text>
          {template.items.length === 0 ? (
            <Card>
              <EmptyState icon="list-checks" title="No items yet" hint="Add the first thing you always pack." />
            </Card>
          ) : (
            <List>
              {template.items.map((item, index) => (
                <ListItem
                  key={`${index}-${item}`}
                  title={item}
                  trailing="Remove"
                  onPress={() => saveItems(template.items.filter((_, other) => other !== index))}
                />
              ))}
            </List>
          )}
        </Stack>

        <Card>
          <Stack>
            <TextInput label="New item" value={draft} placeholder="Torch and spare batteries" onChange={setDraft} />
            <Button label="Add item" icon="plus" disabled={draft.trim() === ''} onPress={addItem} />
          </Stack>
        </Card>

        <Button label="Done" variant="secondary" icon="check" onPress={() => nav.back()} />
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  );
}

// ── Trip Checklist: the running trip, ticked off as you go ────────────────────
function Trip() {
  const [trip, setTrip] = useState<Trip | null>(null);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    storage.kv
      .get('activeTrip')
      .then((saved) => {
        if (live) setTrip(readTrip(saved));
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (live) toast('Couldn’t load the trip.');
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const save = (next: Trip) => {
    setTrip(next);
    storage.kv.set('activeTrip', next).catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save that.'));
  };

  const toggle = (index: number) => {
    if (trip === null) return;
    save({
      ...trip,
      items: trip.items.map((item, other) => (other === index ? { text: item.text, checked: !item.checked } : item)),
    });
  };

  const addItem = () => {
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (trip === null || text === '') return;
    save({ ...trip, items: [...trip.items, { text, checked: false }] });
    setDraft('');
    setAdding(false);
  };

  const checked = trip === null ? 0 : trip.items.filter((item) => item.checked).length;
  const total = trip === null ? 0 : trip.items.length;
  const allDone = total > 0 && checked === total;

  return (
    <Screen
      title={trip === null ? 'Trip' : trip.name}
      action={trip === null ? undefined : { icon: 'plus', label: 'Add an item', onPress: () => setAdding(true) }}
    >
      <Stack gap="lg">
        {trip === null ? (
          <Card>
            <EmptyState icon="list-checks" title="No trip in progress" hint="Go back and start one from a template." />
          </Card>
        ) : (
          <>
            <ProgressBar
              value={total === 0 ? 0 : checked / total}
              tone={allDone ? 'positive' : 'primary'}
              label={`${checked} of ${total} packed`}
            />
            {allDone && <Badge label="All packed — have a good trip" tone="positive" />}
            {total === 0 ? (
              <Card>
                <EmptyState icon="list-checks" title="Nothing on this list" hint="Tap + to add the first item." />
              </Card>
            ) : (
              <>
                <List>
                  {trip.items.map((item, index) => (
                    <ListItem
                      key={`${index}-${item.text}`}
                      title={item.text}
                      icon={item.checked ? 'circle-check' : 'square-check'}
                      trailing={item.checked ? 'Packed' : undefined}
                      onPress={() => toggle(index)}
                    />
                  ))}
                </List>
                <Text size="caption" color="text-muted" align="center">
                  Ticking items here only changes this trip — the template stays as it is.
                </Text>
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </Stack>

      <Modal visible={adding} title="Add an item" onClose={() => setAdding(false)}>
        <Stack gap="lg">
          <TextInput label="Item" value={draft} placeholder="Passport" onChange={setDraft} />
          <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">This goes on your trip only — your template stays as it is.</Text>
          <Button label="Add to trip" icon="plus" disabled={draft.trim() === ''} onPress={addItem} />
        </Stack>
      </Modal>
    </Screen>
  );
}

export default defineApp({
  name: 'Trip Checklists',
  initial: 'Templates',
  screens: { Templates, Editor, Trip },
  capabilities: ['storage'],
  schema: SCHEMA,
  tint: ['ocean', 'indigo', 'slate'],
  icon: 'list-checks',
});
